Post 1
📉 ASX 200 shed 91.40pts or 1.04% to 8,730.40 — a 20-day low. Materials cratered 3.68% as the index logs a brutal 4.55% five-day loss. Year-to-date gains: virtually zero. The rally has been handed back. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
⛏️ Materials -3.68% and Energy -2.08% dragged the market. Telcos +1.05% and IT +0.96% were the only real offsets. When defensives lead and resources bleed, risk appetite is clearly on the exit ramp. #ASX #mining #energy

Post 3
🔻 A2 Milk collapsed 11.03% to AUD 6.450 — worst on the board. That is a single-session wipeout that demands an explanation. Whatever spooked the market here, it went well beyond a routine sell-off. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,584.42/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6694. Silver AUD 67.73/oz. Metals priced high in AUD terms yet miners still sold off hard — the sector pain ran deeper than commodity prices alone. #gold #silver #ASX #metals

Post 5
Five-day loss of 4.55% and a fresh 20-day low. The line in the sand is 8,730. Does Materials find a floor or does the selloff deepen into the week? Drop your level below. #ASX #ausbiz #investing
